subject: Life Skills
title: Oil Smoke Points Matter
description: A quick win: understand Oil Smoke Points Matter.

hook.text: Olive oil in a smoking pan doesn't just taste bad. It releases compounds that can harm your lungs.

buildup.text: Every cooking oil has a smoke point: the temperature where it breaks down and burns.

discovery.text: Avocado oil handles high heat. Butter burns fast. Matching oil to method prevents problems.

twist.text: Extra virgin olive oil is great for drizzling, but refined olive oil is actually fine for sautéing.

climax.text: Keep two oils: a high smoke-point one for frying and a flavorful one for finishing dishes.

punchline.text: Right oil, right heat. That's the secret.

quiz.question: What happens when oil goes past its smoke point?
options: It breaks down and releases harmful fumes
It loses all its flavor immediately
